about: science-factory/mvp/gain.py and confront.py (the candidate gain estimate)
text: Without a quality screen the gain is steered by degraded passes at low stage. In known-answer tests built on the real 2024 pass times and gauge record, one-signed faults on a quarter of the lowest-stage passes cut interval coverage to 67 percent and raised false refutation right at the difference that matters to 34 percent and false confirmation there to 9 percent (2000 test cases per setting). In the 2024 record itself one pass with a degraded quality flag, at the year's lowest stage, carries about two thirds of the residual sum of squares. Proposed and written into the plan: exclude passes with reach_q at or above 2 before pairing and report the count.
